name: Nami
notes: Surging Tides (P) only grants allied champions bonus movement speed, so it contributes nothing to the damage fight and is omitted.

The engine casts Tidal Wave (R) automatically at t = 0; Tidecaller's Blessing (E) is cast on herself at the same instant so its empowered charges are already armed when the wave lands 0.5 s later at the end of its cast. Casts go one at a time: R's 0.5 s cast time keeps Nami busy, so E's cast (no cast time) waits until R's cast ends and is cast then.

Aqua Prison (Q) is cast on cooldown; it has a 0.25 s cast time (gen.Q.castTimeS) that keeps Nami busy, and its bubble lands 0.99 s after the cast starts (the wiki's stated combined cast-time-plus-travel figure, gen.Q.travelTotalS), with damage on landing; the cooldown timer starts at the cast, not the landing.

Ebb and Flow (W) is cast on cooldown; it has a 0.25 s cast time (gen.W.castTimeS) that keeps Nami busy, and its damage lands with the cast (no further delay is stated). Only its initial hit on the dummy is counted as damage, since with no allied unit present the bounce cannot find a second unaffected enemy and the dummy is already 'affected' by the initial hit - the most literal reading of the alternating-bounce rule for a solo-dummy fight.

Tidecaller's Blessing (E) has no cast time and is recast on herself on cooldown; its 3 empowered-hit charges are consumed by whichever damage instance lands first among basic attacks, Q, W or R while the 6 s buff is up, and unused charges lapse when it expires. Because it has no cast time, its cast can still not start inside another cast in progress (Q's or W's cast time, or R's opening cast), but it costs nothing itself and does not delay the next attack beyond that.
Nami auto-attacks the dummy in every gap between casts; an attack carries Tidecaller's Blessing's bonus on-hit magic damage whenever a charge is armed.
Tidecaller's Blessing's reduced-damage rule against non-champions does not apply here, since the dummy counts as an enemy champion.
Tidal Wave's travel beyond its 0.5 s cast time is not modeled, since the dummy's distance from Nami is unspecified; its damage is applied when the cast completes.
Mana costs are not modeled: nothing here would exhaust Nami's mana inside a 15 s fight at level 16.
